name: OpenSecureFtpConnection
label: Open Secure FTP Connection
description: Establishes a secure connection to an FTP server using SSL/TLS or SSH.

fields.name: Port
fields.label: Port
fields.description: The port number for the FTP connection (default is 21 for FTPS, 22 for SFTP).

fields.name: SecureFtpProtocol
fields.label: Secure FTP Protocol
fields.description: Specifies the secure FTP protocol to use (SFTP, FTPS explicit, FTPS implicit).

selectOptions.label: SFTP
selectOptions.description: Secure File Transfer Protocol over SSH.

selectOptions.label: FTPS explicit
selectOptions.description: FTP over TLS with explicit encryption.

selectOptions.label: FTPS implicit
selectOptions.description: FTP over TLS with implicit encryption.

fields.name: AuthenticationMethod
fields.label: Authentication Method
fields.description: Specifies the authentication method to use (Username and password, Private key, Private key and passphrase).

selectOptions.label: Private key and passphrase
selectOptions.description: Authenticates using a private key and passphrase.

fields.name: Username
fields.label: Username
fields.description: The username for authentication (required if 'Authentication Method' is 'Username and password').

fields.name: Password
fields.label: Password
fields.description: The password for authentication (required if 'Authentication Method' is 'Username and password').

fields.name: PathToPrivateKey
fields.label: Path to Private Key
fields.description: The path to the private key file (required if using SFTP with private key).

fields.name: PrivateKeyPassphrase
fields.label: Private Key Passphrase
fields.description: The passphrase for the private key (required if using private key with passphrase).

fields.name: ActiveMode
fields.label: Active Mode
fields.description: If true, uses active mode for FTP connection.

fields.name: AcceptUntrustedCertificates
fields.label: Accept Untrusted Certificates
fields.description: If true, accepts untrusted certificates during TLS negotiation.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: The timeout in seconds for the FTP connection attempt.
